name: Witch Doctor Growing Malice raises each Hex of Malice tick by 3% once
contract: Growing Malice 706551: 'Each tick of Hex of Malice increases the damage of the next tick on the enemy by
$582257s1%, stacking $582257u times' (3%, 10 stacks). Each periodic Hex tick procs the debuff 582257, whose
Effect[0] is aura 271 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER (3% per stack, class mask word 1 33554432, the
IsHex flag), so Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken already scales every later tick. The proc also rescaled the
Hex tick amount by (100 + 3 s') / (100 + 3 s) (AscensionWitchDoctorEvents.cpp:220-234): the growth counted
twice, eight ticks summed to 1531 in both final06 runs against 159 x 8.84 = 1405.6 from the tooltip
(cycle 8 lead; with int truncation the double count is exactly 159, 167, 177, 186, 196, 205, 215, 226).
The fix keeps the native aura 271 and drops the rescale. Hex of Malice 504608: instant, 20% base mana,
24000 ms, a tick every 3000 ms (8 ticks), tick 159 at level 60. Control arm first on dummy a without the
talent: 8 ticks of 159 = 1272, judged in [1270, 1274] so a 158 or 160 tick fails it. Then Growing Malice is
learned (a passive: the learn applies its aura) and a second Hex is cast at dummy b: 7 stacks of 582257
after the seventh tick, and 8 ticks summing to 159 + 163 + 168 + 173 + 178 + 182 + 187 + 192 = 1402
(truncated per tick; 1406 if rounded): judged in [1395, 1410], which excludes the double count 1531, the
control 1272 and the 160-tick sum 1411. Crits are suppressed deterministically: Hex ticks roll the caster's
spell crit chance, snapshot when the Hex applies (AscensionWitchDoctorAuras.cpp:183-190, #4308, no 574358
needed; reference spell crit 3.387%), so Reg's Test Aura 984954 (Effect[1] aura 57 spell crit -1000,
3600000 ms, the Necromancer and Witch Doctor no-crit precondition fixture) is set on the doctor before both
casts and the shadow spell crit is read below -900. Hex of Malice is DmgClass 1 (magic), so the aura 52
weapon crit of Effect[0] does not reach it. 823764 removes partial resists and spell_hit_rating 10000 full
resists. Every tick is counted as noncritical, so a stray crit or resist fails the count, never the sum.
